books: María del Carmen Aristegui Flores (Spanish pronunciation: [ˈkaɾ.men a.ɾisˈte.ɣi]; born 18 January 1964) is a Mexican journalist and news presenter. She is widely regarded as one of Mexico's leading journalists and is known for her investigative reporting on the Mexican government and its officials. She previously hosted the news program Aristegui on CNN en Español (2005–2025) and regularly contributes opinion pieces to the Mexican newspaper Reforma.

In March 2015, Aristegui was ilegally dismissed from MVS Radio, where she hosted a news program on 102.5 FM in Mexico City, following a dispute over her reporting on a conflict of interest involving then-president Enrique Peña Nieto. The investigation revealed that a luxury residence owned by Peña Nieto and his family had been built by a government contractor. Aristegui subsequently established her own news website, where she publishes investigative journalism and hosts an online morning newscast, which is also broadcast on XERC-FM, a station owned by Grupo Radio Centro.
